title.zh: 凸透镜成像 · 远近变像
title.en: The Convex Lens · Near or Far, the Image Transforms

desc.zh: 蜡烛离凸透镜的远近一变，像的大小、正倒、实虚全跟着变：越过二倍焦距，像由大变小；越过一倍焦距，像从光屏上跳进眼睛里——实像能被屏接住，虚像接不住、只能看。三条特殊光线，就能把像画出来。
desc.en: Slide a candle toward a convex lens and everything about its image changes — size, orientation, real or virtual. Cross twice the focal length and the image starts shrinking; cross one focal length and it leaps off the screen into your eye: a real image can be caught on a screen, a virtual one can only be seen. Three special rays are all it takes to draw exactly where the image lands.
